- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. 1	package renderer
2	
3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"fmt"
6		"strings"

8		gast "github.com/yuin/goldmark/ast"
9		east "github.com/yuin/goldmark/extension/ast"

11		mast "github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/ast"
12	)
13	
14	// MarkdownRenderer renders goldmark AST back to markdown text.
15	type MarkdownRenderer struct {
16		buf *bytes.Buffer
17	}
18	
19	// NewMarkdownRenderer creates a new markdown renderer.
20	func NewMarkdownRenderer() *MarkdownRenderer {
21		return &MarkdownRenderer{
22			buf: &bytes.Buffer{},
23		}
24	}
25	
26	// Render renders the AST node to markdown and returns the result.
27	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) Render(node gast.Node, source []byte) string {
28		r.buf.Reset()
29		r.renderNode(node, source, 0)
30		return r.buf.String()
31	}
32	
33	// renderNode renders a single node and its children.
34	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderNode(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
35		switch n := node.(type) {
36		case *gast.Document:
37			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
38	
39		case *gast.Paragraph:
40			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
41			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
42				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
43			}
44	
45		case *gast.Text:
46			// Text nodes store their content as segments in the source
47			segment := n.Segment
48			r.buf.Write(segment.Value(source))
49			if n.SoftLineBreak() {
50				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
51			} else if n.HardLineBreak() {
52				r.buf.WriteString("  \n")
53			}
54	
55		case *gast.CodeSpan:
56			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
57			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
58			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
59	
60		case *gast.Emphasis:
61			symbol := "*"
62			if n.Level == 2 {
63				symbol = "**"
64			}
65			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
66			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
67			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
68	
69		case *gast.Link:
70			r.buf.WriteString("[")
71			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
72			r.buf.WriteString("](")
73			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
74			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
75				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
76				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
77				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
78			}
79			r.buf.WriteString(")")
80	
81		case *gast.AutoLink:
82			url := n.URL(source)
83			if n.AutoLinkType == gast.AutoLinkEmail {
84				r.buf.WriteString("<")
85				r.buf.Write(url)
86				r.buf.WriteString(">")
87			} else {
88				r.buf.Write(url)
89			}
90	
91		case *gast.Image:
92			r.buf.WriteString("![")
93			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
94			r.buf.WriteString("](")
95			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
96			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
97				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
98				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
99				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
100			}
101			r.buf.WriteString(")")
102	
103		case *gast.Heading:
104			r.buf.WriteString(strings.Repeat("#", n.Level))
105			r.buf.WriteByte(' ')
106			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
107			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
108				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
109			}
110	
111		case *gast.CodeBlock, *gast.FencedCodeBlock:
112			r.renderCodeBlock(n, source)
113	
114		case *gast.Blockquote:
115			// Render each child line with "> " prefix
116			r.renderBlockquote(n, source, depth)
117			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
118				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
119			}
120	
121		case *gast.List:
122			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
123			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
124				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
125			}
126	
127		case *gast.ListItem:
128			r.renderListItem(n, source, depth)
129	
130		case *gast.ThematicBreak:
131			r.buf.WriteString("---")
132			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
133				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
134			}
135	
136		case *east.Strikethrough:
137			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
138			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
139			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
140	
141		case *east.TaskCheckBox:
142			if n.IsChecked {
143				r.buf.WriteString("[x] ")
144			} else {
145				r.buf.WriteString("[ ] ")
146			}
147	
148		case *east.Table:
149			r.renderTable(n, source)
150			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
151				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
152			}
153	
154		// Custom Memos nodes
155		case *mast.TagNode:
156			r.buf.WriteByte('#')
157			r.buf.Write(n.Tag)
158	
159		case *mast.MentionNode:
160			r.buf.WriteByte('@')
161			r.buf.Write(n.Username)
162	
163		default:
164			// For unknown nodes, try to render children
165			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
166		}
167	}
168	
169	// renderChildren renders all children of a node.
170	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderChildren(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
171		child := node.FirstChild()
172		for child != nil {
173			r.renderNode(child, source, depth+1)
174			child = child.NextSibling()
175		}
176	}
177	
178	// renderCodeBlock renders a code block.
179	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderCodeBlock(node gast.Node, source []byte) {
180		if fenced, ok := node.(*gast.FencedCodeBlock); ok {
181			// Fenced code block with language
182			r.buf.WriteString("```")
183			if lang := fenced.Language(source); len(lang) > 0 {
184				r.buf.Write(lang)
185			}
186			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
187	
188			// Write all lines
189			lines := fenced.Lines()
190			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
191				line := lines.At(i)
192				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
193			}
194	
195			r.buf.WriteString("```")
196			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
197				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
198			}
199		} else if codeBlock, ok := node.(*gast.CodeBlock); ok {
200			// Indented code block
201			lines := codeBlock.Lines()
202			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
203				line := lines.At(i)
204				r.buf.WriteString("    ")
205				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
206			}
207			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
208				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
209			}
210		}
211	}
212	
213	// renderBlockquote renders a blockquote with "> " prefix.
214	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderBlockquote(node *gast.Blockquote, source []byte, depth int) {
215		// Create a temporary buffer for the blockquote content
216		tempBuf := &bytes.Buffer{}
217		tempRenderer := &MarkdownRenderer{buf: tempBuf}
218		tempRenderer.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
219	
220		// Add "> " prefix to each line
221		content := tempBuf.String()
222		lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(content, "\n"), "\n")
223		for i, line := range lines {
224			r.buf.WriteString("> ")
225			r.buf.WriteString(line)
226			if i < len(lines)-1 {
227				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
228			}
229		}
230	}
231	
232	// renderListItem renders a list item with proper indentation and markers.
233	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderListItem(node *gast.ListItem, source []byte, depth int) {
234		parent := node.Parent()
235		list, ok := parent.(*gast.List)
236		if !ok {
237			r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
238			return
239		}
240	
241		// Add indentation only for nested lists
242		// Document=0, List=1, ListItem=2 (no indent), nested ListItem=3+ (indent)
243		if depth > 2 {
244			indent := strings.Repeat("  ", depth-2)
245			r.buf.WriteString(indent)
246		}
247	
248		// Add list marker
249		if list.IsOrdered() {
250			fmt.Fprintf(r.buf, "%d. ", list.Start)
251			list.Start++ // Increment for next item
252		} else {
253			r.buf.WriteString("- ")
254		}
255	
256		// Render content
257		r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
258	
259		// Add newline if there's a next sibling
260		if node.NextSibling() != nil {
261			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
262		}
263	}
264	
265	// renderTable renders a table in markdown format.
266	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderTable(table *east.Table, source []byte) {
267		// This is a simplified table renderer
268		// A full implementation would need to handle alignment, etc.
269		r.renderChildren(table, source, 0)
270	}

1	package parser
2	
3	import (
4		"unicode"
5		"unicode/utf8"
6	
7		gast "github.com/yuin/goldmark/ast"
8		"github.com/yuin/goldmark/parser"
9		"github.com/yuin/goldmark/text"
10	
11		mast "github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/ast"
12	)
13	
14	const (
15		// MaxTagLength defines the maximum number of runes allowed in a tag.
16		MaxTagLength = 100
17	)
18	
19	type tagParser struct{}
20	
21	// NewTagParser creates a new inline parser for #tag syntax.
22	func NewTagParser() parser.InlineParser {
23		return &tagParser{}
24	}
25	
26	// Trigger returns the characters that trigger this parser.
27	func (*tagParser) Trigger() []byte {
28		return []byte{'#'}
29	}
30	
31	// isValidTagRune checks if a Unicode rune is valid in a tag.
32	// Uses Unicode categories for proper international character support.
33	func isValidTagRune(r rune) bool {
34		// Allow Unicode letters (any script: Latin, CJK, Arabic, Cyrillic, etc.)
35		if unicode.IsLetter(r) {
36			return true
37		}
38	
39		// Allow Unicode digits
40		if unicode.IsNumber(r) {
41			return true
42		}
43	
44		// Allow emoji and symbols (So category: Symbol, Other)
45		// This includes emoji, which are essential for social media-style tagging
46		if unicode.IsSymbol(r) {
47			return true
48		}
49	
50		// Allow marks (non-spacing, spacing combining, enclosing)
51		// This covers variation selectors (e.g. VS16 \uFE0F) and combining marks (e.g. Keycap \u20E3, accents)
52		if unicode.IsMark(r) {
53			return true
54		}
55	
56		// Allow Zero Width Joiner (ZWJ) for emoji sequences
57		if r == '\u200D' {
58			return true
59		}
60	
61		// Allow specific ASCII symbols for tag structure
62		// Underscore: word separation (snake_case)
63		// Hyphen: word separation (kebab-case)
64		// Forward slash: hierarchical tags (category/subcategory)
65		// Ampersand: compound tags (science&tech)
66		if r == '_' || r == '-' || r == '/' || r == '&' {
67			return true
68		}
69	
70		return false
71	}
72	
73	// Parse parses #tag syntax using Unicode-aware validation.
74	// Tags support international characters and follow these rules:
75	//   - Must start with # followed by valid tag characters
76	//   - Valid characters: Unicode letters, Unicode digits, underscore (_), hyphen (-), forward slash (/)
77	//   - Maximum length: 100 runes (Unicode characters)
78	//   - Stops at: whitespace, punctuation, or other invalid characters
79	func (*tagParser) Parse(_ gast.Node, block text.Reader, _ parser.Context) gast.Node {
80		line, _ := block.PeekLine()
81	
82		// Must start with #
83		if len(line) == 0 || line[0] != '#' {
84			return nil
85		}
86	
87		// Check if it's a heading (## or space after #)
88		if len(line) > 1 {
89			if line[1] == '#' {
90				// It's a heading (##), not a tag
91				return nil
92			}
93			if line[1] == ' ' {
94				// Space after # - heading or just a hash
95				return nil
96			}
97		} else {
98			// Just a lone #
99			return nil
100		}
101	
102		// Parse tag using UTF-8 aware rune iteration
103		tagStart := 1
104		pos := tagStart
105		runeCount := 0
106	
107		for pos < len(line) {
108			r, size := utf8.DecodeRune(line[pos:])
109	
110			// Stop at invalid UTF-8
111			if r == utf8.RuneError && size == 1 {
112				break
113			}
114	
115			// Validate character using Unicode categories
116			if !isValidTagRune(r) {
117				break
118			}
119	
120			// Enforce max length (by rune count, not byte count)
121			runeCount++
122			if runeCount > MaxTagLength {
123				break
124			}
125	
126			pos += size
127		}
128	
129		// Must have at least one character after #
130		if pos <= tagStart {
131			return nil
132		}
133	
134		// Extract tag (without #)
135		tagName := line[tagStart:pos]
136	
137		// Make a copy of the tag name
138		tagCopy := make([]byte, len(tagName))
139		copy(tagCopy, tagName)
140	
141		// Advance reader
142		block.Advance(pos)
143	
144		// Create node
145		node := &mast.TagNode{
146			Tag: tagCopy,
147		}
148	
149		return node
150	}

## Summary of Markdown Processing Architecture

I've completed a thorough search of the codebase and found a well-structured markdown processing system. Here's the detailed breakdown:

### **1. INTERFACE DEFINITION (Backend)**

**File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go` (lines 31-55)**

The `Service` interface defines the contract for all markdown operations:
```go
type Service interface {
    ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)
    ExtractTags(content []byte) ([]string, error)
    ExtractProperties(content []byte) (*storepb.MemoPayload_Property, error)
    RenderMarkdown(content []byte) (string, error)
    RenderHTML(content []byte) (string, error)
    GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)
    ValidateContent(content []byte) error
    RenameTag(content []byte, oldTag, newTag string) (string, error)
}
```

### **2. CONCRETE IMPLEMENTATION (Backend)**

**File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go` (lines 57-60)**

The `service` struct implements the `Service` interface:
```go
type service struct {
    md goldmark.Markdown
}
```

### **3. FACTORY/CONSTRUCTOR**

**File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go` (lines 84-113)**

`NewService()` creates instances with options:
- Configuration options: `WithTagExtension()`, `WithMentionExtension()`
- Builds a goldmark parser with GFM and custom extensions
- Returns a `Service` interface

### **4. CUSTOM RENDERER IMPLEMENTATION**

**File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go`**

`MarkdownRenderer` struct (lines 14-17) - renders goldmark AST back to markdown:
- `NewMarkdownRenderer()` constructor (lines 19-24)
- `Render()` method (lines 27-31)
- Multiple render helper methods for different node types

### **5. CUSTOM AST NODES**

**Backend Custom Nodes:**

1. **File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/ast/tag.go`**
   - `TagNode` struct: represents `#tag` elements in markdown
   - Extends `gast.BaseInline` from goldmark

2. **File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/ast/mention.go`**
   - `MentionNode` struct: represents `@mention` elements
   - Extends `gast.BaseInline` from goldmark

### **6. CUSTOM EXTENSION IMPLEMENTATIONS**

**File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/extensions/tag.go`**
- `tagExtension` struct (line 11)
- `TagExtension` singleton (line 14)
- Registers tag parser with priority 200

**File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/extensions/mention.go`**
- `mentionExtension` struct (line 11)
- `MentionExtension` singleton (line 14)
- Registers mention parser with priority 200

### **7. CUSTOM PARSERS**

**File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/parser/tag.go`**
- `tagParser` struct (line 19)
- `NewTagParser()` factory (line 22)
- Implements `parser.InlineParser` interface from goldmark
- Parses Unicode-aware `#tag` syntax (max 100 runes)

**File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/parser/mention.go`**
- `mentionParser` struct (line 19)
- `NewMentionParser()` factory (line 22)
- Implements `parser.InlineParser` interface from goldmark
- Parses `@mention` syntax (max 32 chars, email-aware)

### **8. SERVICE INSTANTIATION (Backend)**

**File: `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go` (lines 35, 47-51)**

The API service holds a reference:
```go
type APIV1Service struct {
    // ...
    MarkdownService  markdown.Service
}

func NewAPIV1Service(...) *APIV1Service {
    markdownService := markdown.NewService(
        markdown.WithTagExtension(),
        markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
    )
    return &APIV1Service{
        MarkdownService: markdownService,
        // ...
    }
}
```

### **9. SERVICE CONSUMERS (Backend)**

1. **File: `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (lines 14-19)**
   - `Runner` struct holds `MarkdownService markdown.Service`
   - Calls `ExtractAll()` to rebuild memo payloads

2. **File: `/bench/home/work/server/router/rss/rss.go` (lines 42-65)**
   - `RSSService` struct holds `MarkdownService markdown.Service`
   - Uses it for rendering RSS feeds

3. **File: `/bench/home/work/server/server.go` (lines 76, 85)**
   - APIv1Service created and its MarkdownService shared with RSSService

### **10. FRONTEND MARKDOWN RENDERING**

**Frontend uses React-based architecture with remark/rehype plugins:**

**Main Renderer: `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx`**
- Uses `ReactMarkdown` component
- Applies custom remark plugins (tag, mention parsing)
- Maps components for custom rendering

**Custom Remark Plugins:**

1. **File: `/bench/home/work/web/src/utils/remark-plugins/remark-tag.ts`**
   - `remarkTag()` plugin parses `#tag` syntax
   - Creates `TagNode` objects in MDAST
   - Unicode-aware with max 100 chars

2. **File: `/bench/home/work/web/src/utils/remark-plugins/remark-mention.ts`**
   - `remarkMention()` plugin parses `@mention` syntax
   - Creates `MentionNode` objects in MDAST
   - Email-aware, max 32 chars

### **11. FRONTEND TYPE DEFINITIONS**

**File: `/bench/home/work/web/src/types/markdown.ts`**

Type interfaces for AST nodes:
- `TagNode` and `MentionNode` interfaces
- Data properties for rendering
- Type guard functions: `isTagElement()`, `isMentionElement()`, `isTaskListItemElement()`

### **12. FRONTEND COMPONENTS**

**Component Rendering:**

1. **File: `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoContent/Tag.tsx`**
   - `Tag` component renders tag spans
   - Handles click events for filtering
   - Applies user-defined tag colors

2. **File: `/bench/home/work/web/src/components/MemoContent/Mention.tsx`**
   - `Mention` component renders mentions
   - Checks if mention is resolved to link or plain text
   - Links to user profile pages

### **13. EXTRACTED DATA STRUCTURE**

**File: `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go` (lines 20-25)**

```go
type ExtractedData struct {
    Tags     []string
    Mentions []string
    Property *storepb.MemoPayload_Property
}
```

---

## Architecture Pattern Summary

This is a **Strategy pattern + Plugin architecture**:

- **Interface**: `Service` defines the contract
- **Implementation**: `service` struct with goldmark parser
- **Plugins**: `TagExtension`, `MentionExtension` extend goldmark
- **Parsers**: `tagParser`, `mentionParser` implement goldmark's `InlineParser`
- **Renderer**: Separate `MarkdownRenderer` for markdown-to-markdown conversion
- **Consumers**: API, RSS, Payload rebuilder services depend on the interface
- **Frontend Mirror**: Parallel remark/rehype plugin system on the web side

This design allows swapping implementations while maintaining the same interface across all consumers.
